name: Ishuzoku no Torikohime ~Semete Ningen no Aite o Sasete!~
original_name: 異種族の虜姫 ～せめて人間の相手をさせて！～
source:
No society is safe from the hands of the almighty Demon King Damocles.

When the princesses of the Velzerdi Dynasty and the Orwood Elf Kingdom are captured, they chose to undergo two weeks of sexual endeavors in exchange for the safety of their people.

Will they endure this terror? Or will the events they encounter consume their minds?
translation:
任何社会都无法逃脱万能的魔王达摩克利斯的魔掌。

当维泽尔迪王朝和奥伍德精灵王国的公主们被俘获后，她们选择用两周的性苦役来换取子民的安全。

她们能忍受这种恐怖吗？还是她们所遭遇的一切会吞噬她们的理智？
